title: The Witness of Little Hawley
author: E. M. Whitlock
blurb: Tamsin Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
